entities.name: Auror
entities.description: A barbarian village in a mountain valley in the Pardic Mountains on Otaria, Dominaria.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: A dwarf war veteran accepted into the barbarian tribe of Auror.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A war veteran from Auror who brought Balthor to his village.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Owner of a staff that Balthor reforged into a sword.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Matoc's grandson who brought the Mirari-infused sword to Auror.

entities.name: Talon
entities.description: Kamahl's greatest challenger, who took leadership of the barbarian tribes.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned to Otaria to view the damage.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The conflict brought to Auror by Kamahl.

events.summary: In 4205 AR Balthor Rockfist and Matoc arrived at Auror; Balthor fought Galdan in a duel and was accepted into the tribe.
events.quote: Galdan accepted Balthor into their tribe

events.summary: Balthor reforged Urza's staff into a great sword for Matoc.
events.quote: Balthor then reforged Urza 's staff, recovered in battle, into a great sword for Matoc

events.summary: Kamahl brought the Mirari-infused sword to Auror and forced a challenge; the barbarians refused to follow him, and after wounding his sister he ceded leadership to Talon.
events.quote: ceded the leadership over the barbarian tribes to Talon

events.summary: In 4500 AR Jeska returned to Auror and found it in ruins.
events.quote: she noted that the buildings were all in ruins

relations.note: Took leadership of the barbarian tribes from Kamahl.
relations.quote: ceded the leadership over the barbarian tribes to Talon
the war veterans Balthor Rockfist and Matoc arrived at Auror
